title: Razorpay
summary: Full-stack financial solutions for Indian businesses: online payment acceptance, payouts, banking and payroll, built after the founders saw how hard it was for Indian startups to accept payments online.

title: Meesho
summary: An online marketplace that makes e-commerce accessible for India's next billion users and lets small businesses and individual entrepreneurs sell online.

title: Stripe
summary: Economic infrastructure for the internet: developer-first software for businesses of every size to accept payments and manage their business online.

title: Gusto
summary: Payroll, benefits and HR for small and growing businesses, so owners can take care of their team without a dedicated HR department.

title: Deel
summary: An all-in-one HR and payroll platform for global teams, combining hiring, payroll, compliance and benefits across many countries.

title: DoorDash
summary: Connects customers with local restaurants and stores through on-demand delivery, giving local businesses a way to reach customers online.

title: Instacart
summary: A marketplace for same-day grocery delivery and pickup from local stores, using personal shoppers for fulfilment.

title: Rappi
summary: An on-demand delivery super-app for Latin America covering food, groceries and retail, with financial services layered on top.

title: Homejoy
summary: An online marketplace matching households with background-checked home cleaning professionals, booked in a few clicks.

title: Atrium
summary: A technology-powered law firm for startups that tried to replace the billable hour with software-driven, fixed-fee legal services.

title: Cleanly
summary: On-demand laundry and dry-cleaning pickup and delivery, scheduled around the customer's time through an app.

title: Bloom Institute of Technology
summary: An online coding school (formerly Lambda School) that trains students and is paid through a share of income once graduates land a job above a threshold.

title: Zapier
summary: Workflow automation for small and mid-sized businesses that connects thousands of work apps without code.

title: AI for the Aging Population
summary: Caregiver shortages are growing while little technology is built for older adults. YC wants voice-first AI products, safety monitoring and care tools that help older people stay independent and support family caregivers.

title: New Operating Systems for the Physical World
summary: Most workers don't sit at a desk, and software for construction, maintenance and field operations has barely changed. YC wants AI-native systems that quote, dispatch, schedule and bill across humans, robots and agents.

title: AI-Native Compliance Infrastructure
summary: Financial compliance is still spreadsheets, point tools and headcount, and the cost grows as companies expand into new markets. YC wants AI that monitors regulatory change, flags anomalies, generates reports and keeps audit trails.

title: AI-Powered Consumer Products for 1 Billion People
summary: Every platform shift creates consumer giants, and AI agents are becoming capable and cheap enough to act like a person on a user's behalf. YC wants new AI-first consumer products with mass-market reach.

title: A Cloud for Small Software
summary: Agents make it easy to build purpose-built tools for one person or a small team, but deploying and sharing them is still hard. YC wants a cloud designed for this long tail of bespoke internal software.

title: Multiplayer AI
summary: The best work tools won by going multiplayer, but working with AI is still mostly single-player chat. YC wants products where teams and AI agents collaborate in shared spaces.
